name: 425. DashScope Qwen-Image and Z-Image sync generation and edit meet the contract (dashscope images) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6607, contract C3, C4, C5, C6, C7. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. The dashscope provider there points at the fixture, whose multimodal-generation answer is picked by the model in the body: qwen-image-2.0 (as many links as parameters.n, usage.image_count), z-image-turbo (one link, the rewritten prompt, token counts with reasoning_tokens), qwen-image-moderated (HTTP 400 DataInspectionFailed), qwen-image-empty (a 200 with no choices). Before the change every dashscope image request answered 400 unsupported_operation. The rows pin: the documented body (input.messages with the input images first and the text last, parameters with size as width*height, prompt_extend and watermark from the caller's extra fields); usage.output_images from usage.image_count; a link input image sent unchanged and bytes sent as a base64 data URI; the four task control fields, resolution (Alibaba documents no resolution parameter for Qwen-Image), response_format b64_json and Z-Image n=2 refused with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter before any upstream call; a Wan model refused on the sync routes (Wan is task-based and waits for the image task routes); a moderation 400 as caller_content_filtered; an empty 200 as provider_empty_result. The rows read back the bytes that reached the fixture from /__wire. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: dashscope/qwen-image-2.0 /v1/images/generations n=2 size 1536x1024 with x-bf-api-key: one upstream call carrying the documented multimodal-generation body, two links and usage.output_images 2 back (dashscope images)

exec: pm.test('dashscope images setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture's DashScope image endpoint, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/pp/dashscope/api/v1/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation'; })); }); }
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, text).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('data carries the two links DashScope returned, in order', function () {
pm.test('usage.output_images is the image_count DashScope reported, with no token counts', function () {
pm.test('size is the width and height DashScope reported', function () { pm.expect(body.size, text).to.equal('1536x1024'); });
pm.test('exactly one request reached DashScope', function () { pm.expect(calls.length, JSON.stringify(calls)).to.equal(1); });
pm.test('the body is the documented shape: input.messages and parameters, size as width*height', function () {

pm.expect(JSON.parse(calls[0].body), calls[0].body).to.eql({ model: 'qwen-image-2.0', input: { messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [{ text: 'a lighthouse at dusk' }] }] }, parameters: { n: 2, size: '1536*1024', negative_prompt: 'low quality', seed: 42, prompt_extend: true, watermark: false } });
